reports.title: Septerna Highlights Business Progress and Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

desk.headline: Collaboration revenue down 12% to $18.9m, miss; loss of $0.57/share; cash runway to at least mid-2029

other.label: Net loss
other.change: vs net income of $8.2m a year ago

results: Revenue, all from the Novo Nordisk collaboration, fell 12% to $18.9m: $11.0m research services, $5.2m milestones and $2.7m of the $195m upfront payment.
Net loss was $26.6m ($0.57 a share), wider than the $0.40 expected; a year ago a $12.5m asset-sale gain gave a profit.
R&D costs rose 51% to $36.6m as SEP-479 moved through Phase 1; there was also a $4.6m tax charge.
Septerna picked SEP-204, an oral pill for Graves' disease and thyroid eye disease, as its next development candidate.

guidance.summary: No financial guidance, as usual for a clinical-stage biotech. Septerna says its cash funds operations at least into mid-2029 and gives trial timelines instead.

watch: First human data for oral PTH1R agonist SEP-479 in Q1 2027.
Start of the SEP-204 Phase 1 trial in Q1 2027.
Further Novo milestones ($13m earned so far) and plans for SEP-631.
